distribution.narrative: EF1984 reports 云南（丽江），西藏（波密，察隅）. CO2015 reports 云南，西藏. Published geographic evidence only; original regional occurrence assessment remains unchanged and requires separate review.

host_note: Host names reported by cited sources, not independently confirmed. The regional occurrence assessment is not changed. Prunus persica Chinese name corrected to 桃, while preserving the reported scientific name.
